name: mcp__robot__act
mcp__robot__observe
description:
Read current RGB, measured TCP positions, pitch/roll/yaw degrees relative to the downward reference, permissions and budgets without advancing physics. Display floats use at most three decimal places.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__robot__observe(args: {}): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

name: mcp__robot__vla_propose
description:
Predict a trajectory without moving. Give one short English sentence describing an immediate action, the observed object and a destination when needed; use task/demo wording and omit reasoning, code and multi-step plans. Example: Move the left gripper above the blue 8. Return a short proposal_id (p1, p2, ...) and TCP samples at steps 5,10,...,50. A new request replaces an unexecuted old proposal.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__robot__vla_propose(args: { subgoal: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```
